name: folio-core
description: The tool surface: MCP assembly, contract and projection, skills-and-tools, tool authoring and tool coverage. It sits in the `tools` topic and keeps the package name folio-core, which is what skill_fetch takes and what `package_name` defaults to (bean pzwb). Synced into a content repo as a folio-core bundle. The knowledge-graph, library, UI, conduct, process, authoring and SDLC skills moved into their topics (bean 9umr).
